text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after reaching a milestone
in my time with <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A proposal! Trainer <username>!
Are you free this coming weekend?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Allow me to guide you to my very special spot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If someone like Chairwoman Akikawa recommended it, it must be great.
Full of anticipation, I waited for the promised day――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Spectacular turnout! It's so bustling here today!
Everyone is eagerly awaiting the race!
choice_data_list: To think this was your special spot……

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! My apologies!
Was it a little too familiar a place?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's a precious place, isn't it?
For us, and for the Umamusume alike.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――Hey, Trainer <username>.
Do you remember <chrname>'s debut race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I still remember. The nervousness when stepping into the waiting room for the first time.
The feeling of sending <chrname> out onto the grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I still remember. The roaring heat of the crowd.
The way <chrname> ran. Everything.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I remember as well.
How everyone looked... including <chrname> and the others.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, that was no metaphor, you know?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe not as closely as you trainers, but I've watched those girls give it their absolute all right by their side.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And for all the days to come.

text_block_list.name: Paddock Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I'll do my bestã¼ã¼!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――Whoa! Splendid vigor!
The Umamusume for race 1 are already stepping out!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe.
That girl gives a booming morning greeting as well.
Admirable! She brings that same momentum to the real stage.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Not only her,
her Trainer is also remarkably lively—

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Gooooo!
You are absolutely number oneee!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Aren't they quite the pair of kindred spirits?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――Oho, and here comes horse girl number 2!
That girl is quite the "formidable" racer!

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
D-D-D... Don't be nervous!
J-J-Just take a deep breath like usual...!

text_block_list.name: Paddock Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing great, Trainer!
Don't you worry――just sit back and watch!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! They are bonded by a unique trust between a worrier of a trainer and their trainee!
Such an endearing mismatched duo!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And girl number 3, she's very attentive.
Even with the staff――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: Did you seriously memorize all of our faces――?!
Did you seriously memorize all of our faces――?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! Be they Umamusume or Trainers,
everyone is a member of our academy!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Your face and your achievements are firmly engraved in this heart of mine!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――Haha.
Yeah, for real. That's why――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
There are those watching who know
you've crossed mountains and valleys to reach where you are today.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That person has always believed in you, and always will.
They have no doubt you can overcome any hardship.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Please keep this in a corner of your heart. Know that there is someone who believes in you and is cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after watching over the Umamusumes' debut races
alongside Chairwoman Akikawa...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Alright! Now then, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll head out and have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
No matter how much you grow, a break is essential!
You must never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: So let's keep hanging out like this. ...Even if just once in a while. Somewhere, together.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore! Right now, I crave
vanilla ice cream. ...How about you?
choice_data_list: You're right... Shall I keep you company?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Much obliged! In that case, why don't we
head straight over to my "special" coffee shop!
